dcterms:description: A publicly available dataset for city Hangzhou, China. The road structure in this dataset is a 4 × 4 grid and the duration of the traffic flow is one hour.
dcterms:title: DHangzhou

dcterms:description: This real-world dataset is collected from Hefei, China, which consists of four heterogeneous intersections. The information of vehicles and roads are recorded by the camera in the nearby intersection facing the vehicles, as well as corresponding timestamps over the time period from 11/06/2018 to 11/12/2018.
dcterms:title: DHefei

dcterms:description: Synthetic data generated to test the model under various flexible traffic patterns. The dataset includes a 6 × 6 grid network with unidirectional traffic and another with bidirectional traffic.
dcterms:title: U nidirec6×6

dcterms:description: Synthetic data generated to test the model under various flexible traffic patterns. The dataset includes a 6 × 6 grid network with bidirectional traffic.
dcterms:title: Bidirect6×6
